research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Tractable is researching remote vehicle damage assessment and remote vehicle inspection using mobile devices that capture images or video of vehicle parts, then classify and visually inspect them to generate feedback and damage estimates. It is also developing a method of universal automated verification of vehicle damage and semi automatic labelling of datasets, alongside an artificial intelligence coach for optimizing insurance claims operations. Together these efforts target vehicle inspection, damage estimation, data labelling, and claims performance analysis.

overview_description.description:
Tractable is a software company that develops artificial intelligence for accident and disaster recovery. Through the use of deep learning to automate visual damage appraisal, Tractable's AI looks at photos of the damage and predicts repair costs. By providing its AI to the largest insurers worldwide, Tractable helps to settle claims quickly and efficiently, which in turn impacts livelihoods.

Tractable AI Review and AI Estimating products help them improve their claims processes and produce live, end-to-end estimates of vehicle damage. Tractable’s pitch is that AI appraisals of damage to vehicles/property can take place via its platform “in minutes”, thereby allowing for repairs to begin sooner and people’s livelihoods to be restored more quickly. It also automates image recognition tasks with Deep Learning.

The company was established in 2014 and is based in London, England.

product.name: AI-Powered Vehicle Damage Assessment
product.description: An AI solution that evaluates vehicle damage from photos to generate repair estimates and accelerate auto insurance claims processing.

product.name: AI-Powered Subrogation Solution
product.description: An AI application that reviews subrogation claims by analyzing estimates and photos to ensure compliance with insurer policies and flag exceptions for negotiation.

product.name: Property Estimator
product.description: An AI tool that assesses home damage from photos submitted by policyholders to generate repair estimates and accelerate property insurance claims.

product.name: Straight-Through Processing (STP) for Claims
product.description: An AI-driven automation platform enabling fully or partially touchless processing of insurance claims from first notice of loss to settlement.

product.name: GaLeNet Multimodal Disaster Assessment Framework
product.description: A multimodal AI framework that integrates pre-disaster images, weather data, and hurricane trajectories to assess disaster damage severity.
